title: Quantitative-Only Research Amendment and Human Review Prerequisite Waiver
authorization_source: Gary Yang explicit election to waive discretionary human blinded chart review and proceed with quantitative-only feature registry freeze based on completed development evidence
amendment_scope: This amendment supersedes ONLY the requirement that the blinded human chart review study be completed before the final feature registry can be frozen. It truthfully records the human chart-review path as waived and not executed, preserves all D3A tooling without claiming human labels, and establishes a quantitative-only feature freeze based strictly on completed development evidence from LONG-002C, LONG-002D1, and LONG-002D2.

d3a_tooling_disposition.future_reactivation_rule: Any future reactivation of human chart review requires separate explicit Gary Yang authorization, preservation of blinding, cannot silently modify an active LONG-002E feature registry, and requires a formal development amendment.

governance_invariants: Human blinded review was waived by Gary Yang before execution and contributed no evidence.
Prior completed development evidence from LONG-002C, LONG-002D1, and LONG-002D2 remains the sole quantitative evidence base.
Point-in-time data requirements remain strictly enforced.
Development-only tuning rules remain strictly enforced.
Feature registry freeze is required before any LONG-002E model experiments.
Model search budget remains strictly bounded to at most 48 material configurations (36 round 1 across 3 families + 12 round 2).
Experiment ledger requirement is strictly preserved for every attempted configuration.
Validation split (2021-2022) remains unopened and strictly quarantined.
Holdout split (2023-2025) remains untouched, unread, and strictly quarantined.
Allowed model families remain strictly bounded to the 3 preregistered families.
Promotion gates remain unchanged (holdout support authorizes only prospective shadow consideration).
Production authorization rules remain unchanged; APPROVED_PRODUCTION_STRATEGIES remains empty.
All upstream specification hashes remain unchanged.
